reason: Reserve time to deliver the originally requested held-out evaluation, including an honest loss if no research candidate is competitive.
decision_time: After teacher32-v1 completes and its numerical worker exits; otherwise at research cutoff after preserving checkpoints and confirming our worker exited. No additional trial is queued.

runtime_forecast.rule: Eligible only if (final_battles+canary_battles)*seconds_per_battle*safety_multiplier+closing_reserve_seconds fits the original time remaining at the recorded decision instant. Forecasts are budget assumptions, not measured final timings.
runtime_forecast.basis: Completed relational confirmation averaged 1497.25/256=5.8486328125 seconds per battle; averaged-policy confirmation 1469.25/256=5.7392578125; planning confirmation measured8.941652343749865.

selection_rule: Highest fresh-confirmation point score among eligible completed source-run winners; earliest candidate_order entry wins exact ties. This is model selection, not a claim of a significant cross-study improvement.
validation_gate_amendment: For this one budget-final benchmark, a validation lower95 above50% is not required. Full verified fresh validation and a matching actual validation-only game canary remain required. This changes evaluation eligibility only, not the final reliable-win criterion.
final_lock: Lock one selected source/model/method, all artifact hashes, this plan hash and decision receipt before final games. No selection or tuning from final outcomes, no resumed research after selection.
final_team_split: test; both teams, sorted home-species composition partition unchanged
reliable_win_criterion: Both mixed-field lower95 bounds above0.5 and standard-field upper95 at least0.5. Completed all3 blocks required. Otherwise target not met; partials never establish completion.
deadline_action: Never extend original deadline. Stop without restarting, retain partial rows/checkpoints, report unmet target honestly, disable heartbeat after delivering outcome.
canary: 2 mirrored pairings per block, validation teams only, mixed38995/38996 and standard38995; no strength claim or policy selection from canary outcomes.
current_final_runtime: final-v3 remains stricter and will refuse losing policies. Budget-final override must be implemented, tested and frozen in a NEW unused runtime before activation; no source imported by teacher32 may be edited.
